publicationId.description: The prefixed ID of the publication object

type.description: Optionally filter the results by the segment's type.

status.description: Optionally filter the results by the segment's status.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

page.description:
Pagination returns the results in pages. Each page contains the number of results specified by the `limit` (default: 10).
If not specified, results 1-10 from page 1 will be returned.

order_by.description:
The field that the results are sorted by. Defaults to created
`created` - The time in which the segment was first created.
`last_calculated` - The time that the segment last completed calculation. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

direction.description:
The direction that the results are sorted in. Defaults to asc
`asc` - Ascending, sorts from smallest to largest.
`desc` - Descending, sorts from largest to smallest.

expand[].description:
Optionally expand the response to include additional data.
`stats` - Requests the most recently calculated statistics for a segment.
Segment stats are recalculated once daily around 7 a.m. UTC for dynamic segments, but can be manually recalculated at any time in the dashboard. Manual and static segments only calculate once upon upload or creation.

items.description: The segment object. To expand results, see the results endpoint.

id.description: The prefixed ID of the segment.

type.description:
The type of segment.
`dynamic` - The segment is recalculated at set intervals.
`static` - The segment is calculated once at creation.
`manual` - The segment is not calculated at all. The results are created via CSV.

last_calculated.description: The time the Segment was last calculated. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch

total_results.description: The total number of subscriptions that belong in the segment from the last calculation.

status.description:
The status of the segment's most recent calculation.
`pending` - The segment has not been calculated yet.
`processing` - The calculation is in progress, and has not completed.
`completed` - The calculation was successful.
`failed` - Something went wrong during the calculation.

active.description: Dynamic segments are marked inactive if they haven't been used in a specific period of time. Inactive segments will not automatically be recalculated.

open_rate.description: The average open rate of the subscribers in the segment.

total_sent.description: The total number of emails sent to the subscribers in the segment.

percentage_premium_subscribers.description: The percentage of subscribers in this segment who are premium in any tier.

percentage_subscribers_with_referrals.description: The percentage of subscribers in this segment who have referred at least one other subscriber.

unique_emails_clicked.description: The total number of unique emails clicked by subscribers in the segment.

total_delivered.description: The total number of emails delivered to subscribers in the segment.

total_referrals.description: The total number of referrals from subscribers in the segment.

unsubscribed_rate.description: The percentage of subscribers in this segment who have unsubscribed.

total_subscribers.description: The total number of subscribers in the segment.

clickthrough_rate.description: The average clickthrough rate of the subscribers in the segment.

unsubscribed_count.description: The total number of subscribers in the segment who are unsubscribed.

unique_emails_opened.description: The total number of unique emails opened by subscribers in the segment.

premium_subscribers.description: The total number of premium subscribers in the segment.

average_referrals_per_subscriber.description: The average number of referrals per subscriber in the segment.

limit.description: The limit placed on the results. If no limit was specified in the request,this defaults to 10.

page.description: The page number the results are from. If no page was specified in the request, this defaults to page 1.

total_results.description: The total number of results from all pages.
